params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Renata Glasc|Renata}} basic attacks apply a mark that lasts a few seconds and expires when attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, this also deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
params.blurb2: Allied {{tip|champions|champions'}} damaging attacks and {{tip|abilities}} against a marked target will consume the mark to deal {{as|magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Renata's''' {{tip|basic attacks}}<!--not on-hit--> are empowered to apply a mark that lasts 6 seconds, refreshes on subsequent hits and expires when attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, the attack also deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|1 to 2 for 9}}|health}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}}.
params.description2: Allied {{tip|champions|champions'}} damaging attacks and {{tip|abilities}} against a marked target will consume the mark to deal {{as|additional '''bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|1 to 2 for 9}}|health}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|of the target's '''maximum''' health}}.
params.description3: ''Leverage's'' damage is capped at 150 against epic {{tip|monsters}}.
params.notes:
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not block the mark's application.
** {{Pending for test}}: Interaction with mark consumption
* The mark's consumption by an ally respects {{tip|enchantment redirection}}.
* ''Leverage's'' mark will be applied even if the attack misses due to {{tip|blind}}.
* {{pft}} Interaction between mark application and consumption and parry effects ({{tip|block}}, {{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|blind}}{{tt|*|Consumption}}).

blurb.plain: Innate: Renata basic attacks apply a mark that lasts a few seconds and expires when attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, this also deals bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health.

blurb2.plain: Allied champions' damaging attacks and abilities against a marked target will consume the mark to deal magic damage based on the target's maximum health.

description.plain: Innate: Renata's basic attacks are empowered to apply a mark that lasts 6 seconds, refreshes on subsequent hits and expires when attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, the attack also deals bonus magic damage equal to 1% – 2% (based on level) (+ 2% per 100 AP) of the target's maximum health.

description2.plain: Allied champions' damaging attacks and abilities against a marked target will consume the mark to deal additional bonus magic damage equal to 1% – 2% (based on level) (+ 2% per 100 AP) of the target's maximum health.

description3.plain: Leverage's damage is capped at 150 against epic monsters.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Renata Glasc|Renata}} fires a hook in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and briefly {{tip|root|roots}} them. She can recast the ability while the target is rooted.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Renata''' {{tip|airborne|knocks}} the target in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. If the thrown target is a {{tip|champion}}, enemies hit are briefly {{tip|stun|stunned}}.
params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Renata''' fires a hook in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for 1 second, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.

If the {{tip|root}} was applied, '''Renata''' forms a {{tip|tether}} between her and the target for the same duration, causing '''Renata''' to become unable to declare attacks and have her {{as|movement speed}} '''reduced''' by {{as|30%|ms}}.
params.description2: ''Handshake'' can be recast while the tether is active.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Renata''' breaks the tether to {{tip|airborne|knock}} the target in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing the same damage to enemies they pass through. If the thrown target is a {{tip|champion}}, all secondary targets hit are {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
params.cdstart: Starts post-effect if an enemy is hit, on-cast if not
params.notes:
* Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to the primary target and {{tip|area damage}} to secondary targets.
* ''Handshake's'' interaction between its tether and root:
** If the root is not applied, neither is the tether.
** The tether's duration lasts the same as the root duration, even if it is modified by {{tip|tenacity}}.
** If the root is removed, the tether is as well, but not vice versa.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the hook but not the recast's effects as the primary target.
** As a secondary target, the recast's effects will be blocked.
* '''Renata''' may still move while the hook is in flight.
** Her facing direction is locked towards the target direction of the hook.
* While the target is hooked, '''Renata's''' facing direction is considered to be in their direction and not in the one she is moving.
* The {{as|{{sti|movement speed}}}} reduction stacks additively with other {{sti|{{as|movement speed}}}} bonuses.
** It is a negative bonus, not a {{tip|slow}}, and is thus not reduced by {{tip|slow resist}}.
{{Effect at cast time start}}

blurb.plain: Active: Renata fires a hook in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and briefly roots them. She can recast the ability while the target is rooted.

blurb2.plain: Recast: Renata knocks the target in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit. If the thrown target is a champion, enemies hit are briefly stunned.

description.plain: Active: Renata fires a hook in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and roots them for 1 second, during which they are revealed. If the root was applied, Renata forms a tether between her and the target for the same duration, causing Renata to become unable to declare attacks and have her movement speed reduced by 30%.

description2.plain: Handshake can be recast while the tether is active.

description3.plain: Recast: Renata breaks the tether to knock the target in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing the same damage to enemies they pass through. If the thrown target is a champion, all secondary targets hit are stunned for 0.5 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Renata Glasc|Renata}} grants herself or the target allied champion ramping {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} in addition to {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} toward enemies. ''Bailout's'' duration resets whenever the target scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion.
params.blurb2: If the target would {{tip|death|die}} while ''Bailout'' is active, their health is set back to full but they suffer a {{as|true damage}} burn that would kill them over a short time. The target can stop the burn by scoring a {{tip|takedown}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renata''' infuses herself or the target allied champion with a chemtech formula for 5 seconds, granting the target {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while they are facing nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions or minions, with both of the bonuses increasing in effectiveness by {{pp|key=%|type=seconds elapsed|0 to 100 for 21|0 to 5}}. ''Bailout's'' duration resets whenever the target scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion within 6 seconds of damaging them.
params.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|10 to 30}}% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}}|Maximum Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|10*2 to 30*2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*2}}% per 100 AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10 to 20}}% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}}|Maximum Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10*2 to 20*2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*2}}% per 100 AP)}}}}
params.description2:
If the target takes {{tip|death|fatal damage}} while ''Bailout'' is active, they are restored to {{as|100% of their '''maximum''' health}} but suffer a {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} burn equal to {{as|10% of their '''maximum''' health}} every {{rutngt|0.25}} until they reach {{as|'''0''' health}}, during which ''Bailout's'' duration is reset every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. This effect may occur only ''once'' per application of ''Bailout'' while the target already has the buff and is not burning.

The burn will stop once the target scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion within 6 seconds of damaging them, setting their {{as|'''current''' health}} to {{as|20% of their '''maximum''' health}} immediately afterwards.
params.effect radius: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|1300|Radius for movement speed towards enemies}}
params.notes:
* Damage taken in excess of the fatal damage taken does not apply to the target's health after it was restored.
* The self-damage taken is considered {{tip|raw damage}} and is calculated based on the target's '''maximum''' health at the time of taking lethal damage.
* ''Bailout's'' bonuses will not reset in effectiveness if its duration is refreshed.
* ''Bailout'' takes priority over all {{tip|resurrection}} and {{tip|zombie state}} effects.
* ''Bailout'' will stop refreshing its duration while the target is burning after 250 seconds have elapsed.
* ''Bailout'' cannot be used on {{tip|clone|clones}} nor {{tip|zombie state|zombie state}} units.
* If ''Bailout'' is cast on a target that is already burning from a previous ''Bailout'' cast, they can trigger a subsequent health restore as well as be inflicted with another burn. This may occur an infinite number of times as long as the target stays burning and does not reach 0 health.
** Casting ''Bailout'' on a target that already has the buff will only refresh the duration (without resetting the bonuses).
* If the target takes fatal damage during ''Bailout'', upon destroying a turret while being targeted by it, they will receive their own [[Champion gold bounties#General|Shut-Down gold]] (specifically ignoring the ''base'' bounty) instead of being executed.{{bug|1}}

blurb2.plain: If the target would die while Bailout is active, their health is set back to full but they suffer a true damage burn that would kill them over a short time. The target can stop the burn by scoring a takedown.

description.plain: Active: Renata infuses herself or the target allied champion with a chemtech formula for 5 seconds, granting the target bonus attack speed and bonus movement speed while they are facing nearby visible enemy champions or minions, with both of the bonuses increasing in effectiveness by 0% – 100% (based on seconds elapsed). Bailout's duration resets whenever the target scores a takedown against an enemy champion within 6 seconds of damaging them.

description2.plain: If the target takes fatal damage while Bailout is active, they are restored to 100% of their maximum health but suffer a true damage burn equal to 10% of their maximum health every ⟦rutngt⟧ until they reach 0 health, during which Bailout's duration is reset every 0.25 seconds. This effect may occur only once per application of Bailout while the target already has the buff and is not burning. The burn will stop once the target scores a takedown against an enemy champion within 6 seconds of damaging them, setting their current health to 20% of their maximum health immediately afterwards.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renata''' launches a cloud of potent chemicals that travels in the target direction, granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. Enemy champions and minions hit become {{tip|berserk}} for a duration.
params.description2:
''Berserked'' units gain {{sti|{{as|100% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and 25% increased {{tip|size}}. Within their targeting radius, they prioritize attacking the closest unit by the following categories in descending order:
# Their allied champions 
# Allied non-champions
# Allied {{tip|wards}}
# Enemy units (including {{tip|monster|monsters}})
params.angle: {{tt|14{{Degree}}|Angle at which the outermost cloud missiles fan out from Renata times two, accurate}}

params.tips:
* ''Berserked'' enemies that use {{si|Smite}} to execute monsters will gain kill credit, not '''Renata'''.
* Enemies attacked by ''Berserked'' allies with Aspect of the Dragon we also be executed if they're below 20% max health and give Renata the kill credit.
